chapter.heading: Bless the LORD, All You ServantsA song of ascents.
chapter.v:
Come, bless
the LORD,all you servants of the LORDwho serve by nightin the house of the LORD!

Lift up
your hands to the sanctuaryand bless the LORD!

May the
LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth,bless you from Zion.
